title: The Mexican Fiesta Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Mexican Fiesta Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan Mexican fiesta board for 6–8: guacamole, black bean dip, cashew queso, pico de gallo, street corn bites, mango, jalapeños and tortilla chips.
hook: A chips-and-dips party board with three dips, street corn bites, mango with Tajín and plenty of lime. Nobody will ask where the cheese went.
why: The board works on hot, cool, sour and sweet. Creamy guacamole and cashew queso cool things down, jalapeños and Tajín heat them up, lime and pico de gallo keep every bite bright, and mango adds sweet relief.

Black bean dip and street corn make it filling, so it can stand in for dinner at a casual party. Use thick-cut chips that won't snap in the dips, and keep the guacamole covered until the last minute so it stays green.

timeline.what: Make or warm the cashew queso; char the corn in a hot pan.
Make the guacamole and press plastic wrap onto its surface.
Fill bowls with the black bean dip, queso and pico de gallo; slice the mango.
Dust the mango and corn with Tajín; add the jalapeños and lime.
Uncover the guacamole, pile in the chips and tostadas, top with cilantro.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: How do I keep the guacamole from browning?
faq.a: Stir in plenty of lime juice and press plastic wrap right onto the surface until you serve.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 16–18 inch board.
